别名

  • Little Sick Girls ～幼馴染の恋人～

あらすじ

The second-year student Akito is a late-blooming yet stereotypical chuunibyou: engrossed in anime, manga and games, and able to recite lines from memory. Because of this, despite his good looks and attractive voice, he was viewed as a disappointing ikemen. However, he paid no heed to what he believed was mindless drivel and enjoyed his hobbies every day at the school’s anime and game club with his close friend Shunta.

あらすじ

Mitsumi received a short message from his osananajimi Kaguya, who was a year younger than him. When she revealed that she had been set up for an arranged marriage, he regretted not taking action in advancing their relationship. He believes that they share the same feelings and had been satisfied the way things were, but now with the girl who he loves crying before him, he had to immediately make a decision…

item.title: Pure Marriage ~Akai Ito Monogatari - Sakura Hen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lass Pixy
  • 発売日: 2017-12-22
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (34 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Pure Marriage ～赤い糸物語 さくら編～
  • 英語名: Pure Marriage Akai Ito Monogatari - Sakura Hen

あらすじ

Since a few years ago, Touma’s imouto Sakura had become extremely cold to him, treating him almost like a stranger. However, her true feelings became clear when he was to choose either Madoka or Celica as his bride. Realizing his own feelings, Touma chose Sakura as his bride, to her great excitement. With the help of Rudman, they were able to live openly as a couple while being siblings and students. It was the beginning of a married life with a tsuntsun yet doting imouto. One day, Sakura suddenly said that she wanted a baby… not in the future, but right now!

item.title: Pure Marriage ~Akai Ito Monogatari - Madoka Hen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lass Pixy
  • 発売日: 2016-05-27
  • スコア: 6.38/10 (49 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Pure Marriage ～赤い糸物語 まどか編～
  • 英語名: Pure Marriage Akai Ito Monogatari - Madoka Hen

あらすじ

This is the first title by Lass Pixy, one of three low-priced titles, each focused on a different heroine.

Touma has reached a critical turning point of his life. He was asked to marry the daughter of the richest family in town, Serika, after incidentally saving her life. After hearing that he had become Serika’s fiancé, his osananajimi Madoka and imouto Sakura also declared themselves as their fiancées. While they are all very important to him, he can only choose one of them as his bride and they each pressed to be chosen while hiding their real intentions secret.
